english.title: Permit use of lead shot for purpose of shooting with shot gun

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION RESTRICTION ON USE OF LEAD SHOT ENGLAND REGULATIONS 1999

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) permit **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use lead shot for the purpose of shooting with a shot gun

(A)_[on or over any area below high-water mark of ordinary spring tides]_
(B)_[on or over a site of special scientific interest included in Schedule 1 to the Environmental Protection (Restriction on use of Lead Shot) (England) Regulations 1999, namely **(..SPECIFY..).]_
(C)_[a wild bird included in Schedule 2 to the Environmental Protection (Restriction on use of Lead Shot) (England) Regulations 1999, namely **(..SPECIFY..).]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 3 and 5(1) of the Environmental Protection (Restriction on Use of Lead Shot) (England) Regulations 1999.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
permit a person to use lead shot
for the purpose of shooting with a shot gun
on/over any area below high-water mark of ordinary spring tides or
on/over site of special scientific interest/a wild bird

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See Regulation 2 for interpretations regarding 'lead shot', 'shot gun', 'site of special scientific interest' and 'wild bird'.
(ii) This Regulation applies to ENGLAND ONLY.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
